- **Tax assessment objection (Einspruch)** – decide whether to object to Finanzamt Musterstadt's assessment by Wed 21 Oct 2026, sending it by Thu 15 Oct 2026 if you do [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a] [party:pty_mcq97yavgqjy]. If not filed in time, the assessment becomes final.
